retrievalProfile.description: A rugged, urban-country aesthetic featuring a male subject against a brick backdrop with heavy, weathered slab-serif typography and a distressed frame.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a male subject in a denim jacket, positioned against a red brick wall with a shallow depth of field. The image is framed by a white, grimy, distressed border and anchored by large, semi-transparent, weathered slab-serif text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark denim contrasts against the warm, repetitive pattern of the brick wall.
Large-scale typography overlaps the subject's torso to create depth.
The distressed white border contains the composition while adding a vintage, tactile feel.
The subject's gaze is directed off-camera, creating a candid, contemplative mood.
coreInvariants: Weathered/distressed texture overlay on text and borders
Warm-toned brick background with shallow focus
Heavy slab-serif font with western-style spurs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-right, occupying approximately 60% of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold name text at the bottom serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, follow the arm down to the denim jacket, and settle on the large typography at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant provides negative space through the blurred brick wall.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Indigo blue from the denim jacket and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Terracotta red and tan from the brick wall.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white for the distressed border and typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Naturalistic saturation with high contrast in the shadows and highlights of the clothing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with western spurs
letterConstructionRules: Mid-height decorative spurs on the stems
Distressed, eroded texture within the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' features a distinctive leg that kicks out with a sharp terminal
The 'H' and 'E' have centered spurs on the vertical bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, textured decorative slab serif paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for modern contrast.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider line integrated with subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and slab structure.
Captures the spur details and rugged feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man with dark hair and a beard wearing a dark denim jacket, looking to the side. Background is a red brick wall with shallow depth of field. Apply a distressed, grimy white border around the entire frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, weathered slab-serif text in the bottom third. The text should have a grunge texture and slight transparency. Below it, add a smaller sans-serif subtitle with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the border sufficiently distressed and uneven?
Does the large text have visible spurs on the stems?
Is the brick wall blurred to keep focus on the subject?
Is the subtitle tracking wide enough to span the width of the main text?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the main display text
Warmth of the brick wall color
Amount of beard stubble on the subject
mustRedesign: Avoid using generic clean fonts; the texture is essential.
Do not use a solid white border; it must look weathered and 'dirty'.
Ensure the text overlaps the subject slightly to integrate the design.

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between name and title
avoid: Plastic or overly smooth skin retouching

postGenerationChecks: Check that the spurs on the typography are sharp and consistent.
Verify the distressed border doesn't obscure the subject's face.
Ensure the denim texture is sharp and detailed.
Confirm the color palette remains in the earthy/indigo range.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in rugged attire + Brick/Industrial background + Distressed Border + Weathered Slab Serif Typography
